description_en: Queries the automatic backup policy of a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查看PolarDB集群的自动备份策略
name: DescribeBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html operation to query the information about all clusters in a specified region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

AdvancedDataPolicy.description_en:
The details of the advanced backup policy.
This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL
AdvancedDataPolicy.description_zh:
高级备份策略详情。
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

AutoCreated.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup policy is automatically generated by the system. Valid values:

true: The policy is generated by the system.
false: The policy is user-defined
AutoCreated.description_zh:
是否为系统自动生成的备份策略，返回值如下：

true：系统生成策略
false：用户自定义策略

BakType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
F: full backup
BakType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值如下：
F：全量备份

DestRegion.description_en: The destination region of the backup policy

DestType.description_en:
The destination type of the backup policy. Valid values:

level1: level-1 backup
level2: level-2 backup
level2Cross: level-2 cross-region backup
DestType.description_zh:
备份策略目标类型，返回值如下：

level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份

DumpAction.description_en:
The method used to convert a level-1 backup to a level-2 backup. Valid values:

copy: copy
DumpAction.description_zh:
一级备份转二级备份方式，返回值如下：

copy：复制

FilterKey.description_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:

dayOfWeek: weekly scheduling
dayOfMonth: monthly scheduling
dayOfYear: yearly scheduling
backupInterval: fixed interval scheduling

This parameter is returned only when FilterType is set to crontab
FilterKey.description_zh:
调度类型，返回值如下：

dayOfWeek：按周调度
dayOfMonth：按月调度
dayOfYear：按年调度
backupInterval：固定间隔调度

仅当FilterType为crontab时，返回该参数

FilterType.description_en:
The filter type of the advanced policy. Valid values:

crontab: periodic scheduling
event: event-based scheduling
FilterType.description_zh:
高级策略筛选类型，返回值如下：

crontab：周期调度
event：事件调度

OnlyPreserveOneEachDay.description_en:
The 24-hour backup data retention policy. Valid values:
true: Only the first backup set of the day is retained for backups that are older than 24 hours.
false: All backup sets are retained
OnlyPreserveOneEachDay.description_zh:
24小时备份保留策略。
true：超过24小时仅保留当天第1个备份集
false：全保留

OnlyPreserveOneEachHour.description_en:
The hourly backup data retention policy. Valid values:
true: Only the earliest backup set within each hour is retained for backups that are older than 1 hour.
false: All backup sets are retained
OnlyPreserveOneEachHour.description_zh:
每小时备份保留策略。取值如下：
true：超过1小时只保留每小时内最早的备份集。
false：保留全部备份集

RetentionType.description_en:
The retention type of the backup set. Valid values:

never: long-term retention (LTR)
delay: retention for a fixed number of days
RetentionType.description_zh:
备份集保留周期类型，返回值如下：

never：长期保留
delay：固定天数保留

RetentionValue.description_en: The number of days for which backups are retained

SrcRegion.description_en: The source region of the backup policy

SrcType.description_en:
The source type of the backup policy. Valid values:

db: database cluster
level1: level-1 backup
level2: level-2 backup
level2Cross: level-2 cross-region backup
SrcType.description_zh:
备份策略源类型，返回值如下：

db：数据库集群
level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份

AdvancedPolicyOption.description_en:
The advanced backup policy option. Valid values:
enable: Advanced backup is enabled.
disable: Advanced backup is not enabled but can be enabled.
notSupport: Advanced backup is not supported.
This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL
AdvancedPolicyOption.description_zh:
高级备份策略选项。取值范围如下：
enable：已开启高级备份
disable：未开启高级备份，可选择开启
notSupport：不支持高级备份
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

BackupFrequency.description_en:
The backup frequency. Valid values:

Normal (default): regular backup. A backup is performed once a day at a scheduled time.
2/24H: enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 2 hours.
3/24H: enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 3 hours.
4/24H: enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 4 hours.

After enhanced backup is enabled, all backups completed within 24 hours are retained. For backups older than 24 hours, only the first backup completed after 00:00 each day is retained, and all others are deleted.
After enhanced backup is enabled, the backup cycle parameter PreferredBackupPeriod is set to all days of the week by default (Monday through Sunday)
BackupFrequency.description_zh:
备份频率，取值如下：

Normal（默认）：常规备份，每天定时备份一次。
2/24H：增强备份，每2小时备份一次。
3/24H：增强备份，每3小时备份一次。
4/24H：增强备份，每4小时备份一次。

开启增强备份后，备份完成时间在24小时内的备份会全部保留。超过24小时的，系统将仅保留每日00:00点后完成的第一个备份，其他均被删除。
开启增强备份后，备份周期PreferredBackupPeriod参数会默认选择一周内的所有天数（即从周一至周日）

BackupPolicyLevel.description_en:
The current backup policy level. Valid values:
Normal: regular backup
Advanced: advanced backup
This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL
BackupPolicyLevel.description_zh:
当前备份策略等级。取值范围如下：
Normal：常规备份
Advanced：高级备份
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_en:
Specifies whether to retain backups when the cluster is deleted. Valid values:

ALL: All backups are retained with long-term retention (LTR).
LATEST: The last backup is retained with long-term retention (LTR).
NONE (default): No backups are retained
BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_zh:
删除集群时是否保留备份：

ALL：长期保留全部备份。
LATEST：长期保留最后一个备份。
NONE（默认）：不保留备份集

DataLevel1BackupFrequency.description_en:
The backup frequency. Valid values:

Normal (default): regular backup. A backup is performed once a day at a scheduled time.
2/24H: high-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 2 hours.
3/24H: high-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 3 hours.
4/24H: high-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 4 hours.

* This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL.
* If the region of your PolarDB for MySQL cluster does not support the cross-region backup feature, this parameter is not supported. For the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.
* After advanced backup is enabled, use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead of this parameter
DataLevel1BackupFrequency.description_zh:
备份频率，取值如下：

Normal（默认）：常规备份，每天定时备份一次。
2/24H：高频备份，每2小时备份一次。
3/24H：高频备份，每3小时备份一次。
4/24H：高频备份，每4小时备份一次。

* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupPeriod.description_en:
The level-1 backup cycle. Valid values: 
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

* At least two days must be selected. Separate multiple values with commas (,).
* This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL.
* If the region of your PolarDB for MySQL cluster does not support the cross-region backup feature, this parameter is not supported. For the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.
* After advanced backup is enabled, use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead of this parameter
DataLevel1BackupPeriod.description_zh:
一级备份周期，取值范围如下： 
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

* 至少需要选择2天，多个值之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en:
The retention period of level-1 backups. Valid values: 3 to 14. Unit: days.
After advanced backup is enabled, use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead of this parameter
DataLevel1BackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh:
一级备份保留周期，取值范围为3~14，单位为天。
开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupTime.description_en:
The time period during which automatic backups are performed. The value is in the `hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ` format (UTC). The start and end times must be on the hour and exactly 1 hour apart. Example: `14:00Z-15:00Z`.

This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL.
If the region of your PolarDB for MySQL cluster does not support the cross-region backup feature, this parameter is not supported. For the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）
DataLevel1BackupTime.description_zh:
执行自动备份的时间段，格式为`hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ`（UTC时间），且输入的数值必须为间隔1个小时的整点，如`14:00Z-15:00Z`。

PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）

DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRegion.description_en:
The cross-region backup region for level-2 backups. For the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.

After advanced backup is enabled, use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead of this parameter
DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRegion.description_zh:
二级备份跨地域备份区域。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。

开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRetentionPe.description_en:
The retention epoch of cross-region backups for level-2 backups. Valid values:

0: The level-2 backup feature is shutdown.

30 to 7300: The retention epoch of level-2 backups. Unit: days.

-1: Level-2 backups are retained with long-term retention (LTR).


- When a cluster is created, the default value is 0, which means the cross-region backup feature for level-2 backups is shutdown.
- After advanced backup is enabled, use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead of this parameter
DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRetentionPe.description_zh:
二级备份跨地域备份保留周期。取值范围如下：

0：关闭二级备份功能。

30～7300：二级备份保留周期，单位为天。

-1：二级备份长期保留。


- 创建集群时，默认取值为0，即关闭二级备份跨地域备份功能。
- 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies
